senses.zh_definition: 【专名；条件性解释】佐德，通常指 DC 超人故事中的氪星军人佐德将军；尚不能确认输入词 zod 指的就是该人物。
senses.en_definition: Proper name: Zod, especially General Zod, a Kryptonian military figure and antagonist in DC's Superman stories; identification of the supplied token remains unconfirmed.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas Zod, khususnya Jeneral Zod, watak tentera Krypton yang menjadi penentang Superman dalam cerita DC; rujukan token yang diberikan belum dapat dipastikan.
senses.nuances: 应写作 Zod，首字母大写。这是有来源支持的候选指称，不是已验证的马来语普通词义；不得据此标为 official。下列搭配和例句仅示范该专名的使用，不代表已证实的高频普通词搭配。也不能仅凭拼写把它解释成某个阿拉伯或爪夷字母名称。[DC：General Zod 的人物历史](https://www.dc.com/blog/2024/01/05/the-rise-and-fall-and-rise-and-fall-and-rise-of-general-zod)

dual_scenarios.context: 影视评论 / 文化报道；仅示范专名解释
dual_scenarios.ms: Ulasan tersebut membincangkan peranan Jeneral Zod sebagai penentang Superman.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该评论讨论了佐德将军作为超人对手的角色。
dual_scenarios.en: The review discusses General Zod's role as an antagonist to Superman.

spoken_features: 句末 kan 请求确认。
专名 Zod 在口语中仍应保留大写。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)

messages.zh: 我刚看了这个片段，佐德是谁啊？
messages.en: I just watched this clip. Who's Zod?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Jeneral dari Krypton tu. Dia lawan Superman lah.
messages.ms_standard: Dia ialah seorang jeneral dari Krypton yang menentang Superman.
messages.zh: 就是那个氪星将军啊，跟超人对着干的。
messages.en: He's that general from Krypton—the one who fights Superman.

etymology.historical_story: If this token refers to DC's Zod, its relevant history belongs to fictional naming rather than Malay word formation. DC describes General Dru-Zod as a Kryptonian commander associated with the Phantom Zone and conflict with Superman. His name can occur unchanged in Malay discussion of these stories, but that does not establish a Malay common noun or its etymology. [DC: General Zod](https://www.dc.com/blog/2024/01/05/the-rise-and-fall-and-rise-and-fall-and-rise-of-general-zod)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 若指人物，就把 Zod 与“佐德将军、超人的对手”一起记；这是专名联想，不是马来语词根或谐音词源。
